review: Factory lubrication schematic visually reviewed. Filter is on camshaft/main-gallery side of the six-cylinder bearing train. CAD cam is at negative Y, so the prior positive-Y staged filter was on the wrong side.
limits: Only side-of-block relationship is supported. Diagram is schematic, not dimensioned. Coordinates, angle, block boss and insert geometry remain provisional. No source measurement inferred from pixel distances.
additional_callouts: Diagram marks gallery-end hex plugs as 3/8-18 x0.42; exact thread standard and individual mounting datums require corroboration.
